description: Confirm or reject every PROPOSED term of one source at once — a wiki page or an issue the terms were found on — as the terms screen's «Confirm all on this page» does. Read them first with list_terms and that 'source', and pass 'expected': how many proposed terms you read there. If the count is different now (somebody decided some, or the page was read again), nothing is written and the answer says so — read the list again. Confirm only what the person asked for. Members of the project who may write only. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

expected.description: How many proposed terms of this source you read — 'total' of list_terms with state 'proposed' and this source.

kind.description: Only these kinds, comma-separated, as list_terms takes them.

source.description: The source, as list_terms' 'sources' names it: 'page:471', 'issue:KYC-12' or 'none'.

name: decide_terms
